notes: Same site/access as bestsellers pass. Checked robots.txt sitemaps, the es/en/selections-sitemap.xml (423 selection slugs), and direct-URL probes for permanent-clearance terms: /es/en/o/outlet, /es/en/s/outlet, /es/en/o/clearance, /es/en/s/clearance, /es/en/s/liquidacion, /es/en/s/final-sale all returned 404 (default not-found page, title 'Kave Home - Here to Stay'). No 'outlet', 'clearance', 'liquidacion', 'final sale', 'last chance', or 'end of line' slug exists anywhere in the 423-entry selection sitemap or the homepage nav/i18n payload. The only occurrences of 'outlet' on the homepage refer to Kave Home's physical retail outlet stores (promo-code exclusion text), not a product listing. Found and inspected the site's actual discount/sale structure instead: /es/en/o/sale (canonical Sale category page, pageName='Sale', title 'Furniture and decor sale up to 50% | Kave Home') server-renders with Algolia filter pages.categories:sale returning nbHits=1 -- essentially a stale/near-empty static category tag; the real, populated discount listings live under the site's 'selections' engine as two seasonally-named hubs, 'Team Rebajas SS26' (pageName 'Team Rebajas SS26', 466 products) and 'Team Rebajas aw25-26' (pageName 'Team Rebajas aw25-26', 230 products), plus several small room/category sale sub-selections (Outdoor furniture 13, Outdoor decoration/lighting/textiles 13, Outdoor table accessories 1, 'Soft furnishing 40% off' 8, 'Kitchen at 40% off' 1). Applied the brief's Sale-vs-Clearance discipline: these are explicitly seasonal ('SS26'=Spring/Summer 2026, 'aw25-26'=Autumn/Winter 2025-26 -- the site's own two-season sale-cycle naming), carry percent-off/temporal framing ('up to 50% off', '40% off', and the homepage's own embedded copy for this campaign: 'Last days','Last hours','New discounts'), and nowhere use Clearance/Outlet/Final Clearance/Last Chance/End of Line language on-page or in the URL/pageName. This is a textbook generic temporary promotional sale per the brief's own example (Rebajas = 'often just means sale/discount season, not permanent clearance'), so excluded rather than recorded -- not treated as an uncertain/ambiguous case since the seasonal-cycle naming and complete absence of any outlet/clearance term across the full sitemap is decisive evidence, not a borderline judgment call. No genuine Clearance PLP exists on this site.
